sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Computer screens become the prevailing medium for visual-art creation/presentation, with intelligent software collaboration.
reference.rationale: Digital art tools were established, but the broad claim of preference across visual art was stronger than the evidence of availability. AI art receives serious recognition, yet painting, sculpture, print and physical display remain important; there is no defensible universal medium-of-choice ranking here.
